GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, weakened from turn, Vet revealed no abnormalities # on pace/weakened

Jumped only fairly then Eased and Settled Down last 10 Lengths fromn the lead, awkward rounding 800m turn, made no ground to Turn then Made Some Ground close to rail in straight, blocked at 150m but only ordinary once clear. (Blinkers FIRST TIME) # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Made the 800m turn awkwardly. Approaching the 200m was disappointed for a run between.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Best away. Not pushed early & raced well back 3 Wide (6L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to chase 3 Wide @ 600m. Pushed along Six Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 300m & held ground Five Wide in straight. # Never in it.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: At the end of the straight was steadied when awkwardly placed at heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat back 9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
Bit Slow Out sat last 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home ok but never threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat last 6-7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well # ran on from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was crowded for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down 6th Outside 6 Lengths off leader/winner No Pace On hence had a task, Hard Ridden 500m same, kept trying without threatening - # home where settled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was crowded. Rdr reported the gelding did not stretch out and felt uncomfortable in its action. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced well back 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Held Ground until improving Four Wide from 550m & Five Wide @ 450m. Held together Seven Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Worked to challenge leaders @ 250m & pressured @ 200m. Hit lead @ 100m & drew clear late. # Wide/too good.

Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & improving Two Wide from 500m. Held up Four Wide @ 400m & pushed along Seven Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & worked to challenge leaders @ 150m. Got upper hand in last 50m. # Well ridden
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider explained intended taking up mid field pos however was slow into stride and as such settled at rear of field and became detached, added made some endeavour to get mount to stride out but was reluctant to make too much use in early stages. Added from 1000m commenced to shorten margin to remainder of field before commencing run around field from 400m

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Five Wide (2.5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & outsprinted Six Wide in straight. # Wide/stuck on OK
